en.bdb: Fame and disrepute according to the actions

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥ ਸੁਗਰਥੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam arath sugarath saadhasa(n)g aavai|

en.bdb: Truth, contentment, compassion, dharma, wealth, and other best things are attained in the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਮਚਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: kaam karodh asaadh sa(n)g lobh moh aha(n)kaar machaavai|

en.bdb: Association with the wicked increases lust, anger, greed, infatuation and ego.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਹੁਇ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhukirat sukirat karam kar buraa bhalaa hui naau dharaavai|

en.bdb: A good or a bad name is earned on account of good or bad deeds respectively.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਰਸੁ ਗਾਈ ਖਾਇ ਖੜੁ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਜਣਦੀ ਵਗੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: goras gaiee khai khaR ik ik janadhee vag vadhaavai|

en.bdb: Eating grass and oilcakes, the cow gives milk and giving birth to calves increases the herd.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਧਿ ਪੀਤੈ ਵਿਹੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਪ ਜਣਿ ਜਣਿ ਬਹਲੇ ਬਚੇ ਖਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhudh peetai vih dhei sap jan jan bahale bache khaavai|

en.bdb: Drinking milk, the snake vomits poison and eats up its Own progeny.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: sa(n)g subhaau asaadh saadh paap pu(n)n dhukh sukh fal paavai|

en.bdb: The association with the sadhus and wickeds variously produces sin and meirit, sorrows and pleasures.
The fill, inculcates benevolence or evil propensities.
